name: rustpress
description: Standalone VitePress-format docs site generator in Rust

scripts.test: npm run build:js && npm run build:css && cargo test --quiet && npm run check:demo && npm run check:parity && npm run check:viewport
scripts.build:docs: node scripts/gen-theme-index.mjs && cargo run --quiet -- syntax-index docs/static/syntax-highlight.json && cargo run --quiet -- build docs
scripts.dev:docs: npm run watch:css & npm run watch:js & cargo run -- serve docs & wait
scripts.parity:refresh: cp parity/upstream.json parity/upstream.prev.json 2>/dev/null; node scripts/parity-refresh.mjs && cargo run --quiet -- parity snapshot parity/cache --meta parity/cache/meta.json && cargo run --quiet -- parity diff parity/upstream.prev.json parity/upstream.json; rc=$?; rm -f parity/upstream.prev.json; exit $rc
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css && cargo run --quiet -- build demo
scripts.dev: npm run watch:css & npm run watch:js & cargo run -- serve demo & wait
